description: Permissions for the launcher webview (`main`) only. Desktop: each site is a child WebView inside the same window, so the grant is scoped to the `main` webview rather than the window, and site child WebViews get no capability. Android: there is a single WebView, and the site page is loaded into it, so this grant applies to the same WebView that shows sites. Remote origins get no IPC from this file: no `remote` capability is defined, and Tauri 2.11.6 rejects commands from a remote origin unless a remote capability allows them. Android also exposes wry's `ipc` JavaScript interface to pages; the Rust side decides access from the page URL with that same check, not from the interface itself. See docs/android-navigation.md.
